Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIA Naib Court Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIA Naib Court Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the NIA Naib Court recruitment is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Naib Court post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Naib Court post is a 12th Pass. Additionally, candidates need to have at least 2-3 years of experience in handling Naib Court work.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Naib Court position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Naib Court position is 65 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Naib Court post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Naib Court post will be based on the last pay drawn minus the basic pension. This is a common practice for contract-based roles involving retired personnel.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Naib Court post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Naib Court post by the National Investigation Agency (NIA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the NIA Naib Court recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110003. The exact venue address will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity. The recruitment is for a contract period, as indicated by the 'Job Type' being listed as 'Contract'.
